properties.statement:
Someone with no technical background can read reflow2's site and come away knowing what reflow2 is and what it is not, without being intimidated or bogged down.

It is a partnership of three:
- The person brings the ideas and makes every decision.
- An AI drafts, asks what is missing, and checks.
- The graph remembers what was decided, by whom and why, and what was measured. So the reasons outlive the chat, the model and the people who leave.

It is not an AI that does the work, and it does not replace people or their conversations. It gives those conversations a memory and helps people work together.

The site also says plainly:
- reflow2 itself runs no AI.
- Some work does not need it: short, one-person, one-sitting work.
- Which part carries over to a project that is not software.

The story spans two or three pages. The first page stands on its own in plain words, and a deeper page serves those who want more.

ADDED 2026-10-13: Anthony kept option (b) of dec:idea-what-reflow2-can-learn-from-oh-my-pi as intent ("Go with your recommendation on: which oh-my-pi ideas, (a) to (h), to keep"). Coding-agent harnesses now keep their own memory; oh-my-pi's retain and recall are one example. So the "is not" list also says that reflow2 is not an agent's private memory. It says what reflow2 holds that such memory does not:
- it is shared between people and models;
- it is typed and linked;
- it is clear about whose word settles what;
- it is checkable;
- it outlives any one harness.
The served working instructions say the same in one line. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
